name: export-workday-soap-invoice-mapping
summary: Workday Submit_Supplier_Invoice declarative SOAP mapping skeleton — reference-ID header projections, $IF_SCHEMA_ID$-guarded optional refs, amount-coded lines with worktags.

api_version.description: Workday SOAP API version, e.g. v42.2

provenance: Harvested 2026-07-03 from two independent production Workday AP implementations, both running the Rossum-hosted Workday SOAP connector; header + non-PO line shape near-identical in both. Not yet re-validated on a third tenant.
notes: Hook is a webhook (not a function) on annotation_content.export with config.url = {org}/svc/workday/api/v1/export; tenant credentials live in hook secrets. Every optional reference is $IF_SCHEMA_ID$-wrapped with fallback_mapping {} so absent fields drop out of the payload instead of sending empty references. Reference-ID types (Organization_Reference_ID, Supplier_ID, ...) and worktag types are tenant configuration — verify against the tenant. {document_content} (single braces) is the connector-supplied base64 of the source document; @{...} reads schema fields. For PO-based invoices swap the line block for export-workday-po-line-type-projection; for multi-document attachments swap Attachment_Data for export-workday-soap-attachment-data (attachments >50 MB fail through Rossum infra). Business_Process_Parameters carries submit/approval routing (Auto_Complete, approver reference). CANDIDATE: no reference pack documents the connector mapping DSL yet — verify the wsdl block and secrets wiring on a live tenant before promoting.
